description: IBM Security MaaS360 is a software designed for enterprise mobility management, providing organizations with tools to manage and secure mobile devices, applications, and content. It offers features including device enrollment, policy enforcement, threat management, andcompliance monitoring across various operating systems. The software enables IT administrators to gain visibility into device status, configure security settings, and control data access to support organizational security policies. It addresses business needs related to protecting sensitive corporate data, managing a distributed mobile workforce, and ensuring regulatory compliance while facilitating mobile productivity.
